step.label: Request Production Schedule Adjustment
step.description: Initiate a change request to modify production orders based on demand forecasting or supply constraints.
step.useCase: Production planners adjust machine allocation and order sequencing to meet revised delivery commitments.

step.label: Assess Hazardous Material Impact
step.description: Evaluate whether the production change affects handling, storage, or declaration of regulated hazardous substances in the manufacturing process.
step.useCase: Environmental and safety teams confirm that material substitutions or process modifications comply with regulatory thresholds.

step.label: Verify Employee Safety Requirements
step.description: Confirm that affected manufacturing personnel meet updated occupational health and safety certifications required for the modified production process.
step.useCase: HR ensures machine operators and line supervisors have current safety training and clearance for the adjusted production workflow.

step.label: Orchestrate Engineering Change Order
step.description: Coordinate design and technical specifications for the production modification across engineering, manufacturing, and quality systems.
step.useCase: Engineering change management agent automates notifications and approvals when production process modifications affect product design or material bills.

step.label: Document Engineering Change Formally
step.description: Create and publish formal engineering change records to establish traceability and maintain product configuration management.
step.useCase: Product lifecycle managers record change rationale, affected product items, and implementation dates for audit and compliance.

step.label: Coordinate Procurement and Supplier Adjustments
step.description: Update purchase orders and vendor commitments to align supplier delivery schedules and material specifications with the modified production plan.
step.useCase: Procurement specialists revise PO quantities and dates with vendors to synchronize material availability with the new production schedule.

step.label: Orchestrate Production Implementation
step.description: Coordinate material flow, machine configuration, and process sequencing to execute the approved engineering and procurement changes on the production line.
step.useCase: Production agent orchestrates real-time scheduling of machines, material kits, and work orders to implement the change without line disruption.

step.label: Adjust Compensation for Modified Workload
step.description: Recalculate employee compensation and incentives based on revised labor allocation, shift assignments, or skill premium requirements for the modified production roles.
step.useCase: Payroll and HR systems update employee earnings to reflect overtime, new role classifications, or performance adjustments tied to production change success.
